blinding_guess.why: The parameter is declared as expected (name robot_description, xacro output string) in all three upload launch files and all referenced xacro/mesh files exist and parse as XML. Minor oddities (package.xml has no run_depend on xacro although the launch files call $(find xacro)/xacro --inorder; ur5 wrist link inertials use radius="0.6" while other links use ~0.06) do not clearly make the param defective; nothing in the snapshot alone shows a contract break.

notes: ROS1 package; QoS fields are null by rule. The only packet element (param:/robot_description, provides) is set by snapshot:ur_description/launch/{ur3,ur5,ur10}_upload.launch lines 5-6 as <param name="robot_description" command="$(find xacro)/xacro --inorder '...'"/>, choosing <model>_robot.urdf.xacro or <model>_joint_limited_robot.urdf.xacro via arg limited (default false). The name is written relative ('robot_description'); it resolves to /robot_description only when the launch file is run or included in the root namespace; the declares signature copies the name verbatim. msg_type and definition_id are null: a parameter has no message definition. frame is null: the value is a URDF document defining a tree of link frames rooted at link 'world' (world_joint -> base_link, prefix=""), with links base_link, shoulder_link, upper_arm_link, forearm_link, wrist_1_link, wrist_2_link, wrist_3_link, ee_link, base, tool0 and revolute joints shoulder_pan_joint, shoulder_lift_joint, elbow_joint, wrist_1_joint, wrist_2_joint, wrist_3_joint (ur5.urdf.xacro:81-336; same structure in ur3/ur10), so no single frame applies. units null: the code does not state units (URDF itself uses SI). exclusive is empty: ur.transmission.xacro:9-59 declares <hardwareInterface>PositionJointInterface</hardwareInterface> for each ${prefix}*_joint via transmission_interface/SimpleTransmission, which exposes a command interface for the simulated hardware (common.gazebo.xacro:5 loads libgazebo_ros_control.so) but is not itself an exclusive claim. Other external references not expressible in the canonical forms: test.launch:6-7 runs robot_state_publisher/state_publisher and rviz with $(find urdf_tutorial)/urdf.rviz; launch files depend on the xacro package (--inorder flag), which package.xml (run_depend only urdf) does not list. ur10.urdf.xacro:66-72 macro uses name:=default parameters (needs xacro --inorder, which the launch files pass). ros_distro is null, so no distro-specific default was needed.
